command.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.none: Market #%s has no goods a rival guild deals in
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.enabled: Unseen guilds buy up or sell off goods around a market every few days, moving the prices of the region. Shown as news on the board
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.chanceP: Chance of a new campaign per day
Chance (0-1) that a new campaign starts each in-game day
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.maxActi: Most campaigns running at once in the whole world. 0 = none start
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.minDays: Range of days one campaign lasts
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.minImpa: On the last day the center market price is ×(1+impact) (buying up) or ÷(1+impact) (selling off)
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.nearRad: Markets within this many blocks of the center are moved as much as the center
config.ak_trade_expansion.rivals.farRadi: Markets farther than this many blocks from the center are not moved
config.ak_trade_expansion.trend.duration: Each village chooses its popular / plentiful goods groups again after this many days (shifted per market)
config.ak_trade_expansion.trend.popularC: Goods groups in fashion per village. Set both counts to 0 to turn trends off
config.ak_trade_expansion.trend.unpopula: Goods groups out of fashion (cheap) per village
config.ak_trade_expansion.trend.popularM: Range of the multiplier of the base price of popular goods
config.ak_trade_expansion.trend.unpopula: Range of the multiplier (below 1) of the base price of plentiful goods
config.ak_trade_expansion.trend.minGoods: Only groups with at least this many goods at the village can be in or out of fashion
recipe_viewer.ak_trade_expansion.title: Market Prices
recipe_viewer.ak_trade_expansion.none: No market nearby deals in this item. To learn prices farther away, go there or check a bulletin board.

recipe_viewer.ak_trade_expansion.shortag: Shortage: this market wants this item

Carriers and clerks can be hired on the "Staff" tab of the trade screen. They work while you are away (as long as the server runs)
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.maxPerPl: How many employees one player may have at once. Employees who quit do not count
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.minReput: Reputation level with the market (0-5, 2 = Regular). No condition while reputation is off
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.carrierH: Paid when hiring (copper). Includes the first day's wage. Not paid back
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.clerkHir: Paid when hiring (copper). Includes the first day's wage. Not paid back
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.carrierW: Fixed wage per working day from the purse (default 0: carriers are paid by commission). Without enough money it stops
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.clerkWag: Paid from the employee's purse for every day it holds goods. Without enough money it stops working
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.carrierC: Most trading units one trip can carry
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.clerkCap: Most trading units a clerk keeps for sale
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.carrierB: Blocks per in-game day. At 2000, a market 1000 blocks away is 10 minutes one way
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.carrierM: Markets up to this distance (blocks, Nether ×8) can be the destination
When the price at the destination stays below the limit, the carrier waits this many days, then brings the rest back
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.accident: Accident chance of a loaded trip = base + per 1000 blocks × distance ÷ 1000 (up to the maximum)
An accident loses this part of the cargo (0-1, drawn between the two)
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.quitChan: Chance to quit after an accident
After an accident the carrier quits with this chance (0-1, default 0). The rest of the cargo is lost and the fee is not paid back (the purse can be taken)
config.ak_trade_expansion.staff.notifyCh: Tell staff events in the chat
Accidents, quitting, unpaid wages and sold-out clerks are shown in the owner's chat (when online)
